"""Only reviewed local refusal/lock tests; never Docker/SQL clients."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

ROOT=Path('/home/paulo/projects/livenet-v2')


def main():
    import pytest
    import psycopg
    real_popen=subprocess.Popen
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='livenet-dev09a2-local-process-') as folder:
        work=Path(folder)
        forbidden_bin=work/'forbidden-bin';forbidden_bin.mkdir()
        for name in ('docker','psql','pg_dump','pg_restore','alembic','curl','wget'):
            p=forbidden_bin/name;p.write_text('#!/bin/sh\necho EXTERNAL_TOOL_FORBIDDEN >&2\nexit 99\n');p.chmod(0o700)
        os.environ['PATH']=str(forbidden_bin)+os.pathsep+os.environ['PATH']
        def forbidden(*a,**kw):raise AssertionError('external socket/database forbidden')
        socket.create_connection=forbidden;socket.socket.connect=forbidden;psycopg.connect=forbidden
        def checked_popen(command,*args,**kwargs):
            if type(command) not in (list,tuple) or not command or kwargs.get('shell'):
                raise AssertionError('unreviewed subprocess forbidden')
            permitted=False
            if command[0]=='bash' and len(command)==3:
                script=Path(command[1]).resolve();mode=command[2]
                if script.is_relative_to(work):
                    permitted=(script.name=='f066c_admin_psql.sh'
                        and (mode.startswith('inspect:--execute-') or mode=='prepare:--execute-transfer'
                             or mode=='--execute-transfer'))
                elif script.parent==ROOT/'scripts/postgres':
                    permitted=(script.name in ('f066c_run_create_roles.sh','f066c_run_ownership.sh','f066c_admin_psql.sh')
                               and mode=='--execute-transfer')
            elif command[0]==sys.executable and len(command)==5 and command[1:3]==['-u','-c']:
                permitted=('from f066c_authorization_lock import acquire_authorization_lock' in command[3]
                           and Path(command[4]).resolve().is_relative_to(work))
            if not permitted:raise AssertionError('unreviewed subprocess forbidden')
            return real_popen(command,*args,**kwargs)
        subprocess.Popen=checked_popen
        nodes=['scripts/postgres/tests/test_f066c_authorization_lock.py::test_independent_process_lock_exclusion',
          'scripts/postgres/tests/test_f066c_authorization_lock_multiprocess.py::test_lock_exclusion_between_processes',
          'scripts/postgres/tests/test_f066c_executor_inspect.py',
          'scripts/postgres/tests/test_f066c_security.py::test_legacy_executor_blocked',
          'scripts/postgres/tests/test_f066c_security.py::test_direct_admin_execution_blocked']
        code=pytest.main(['-q','--assert=plain','-p','no:cacheprovider','--tb=short','--basetemp',str(work/'pytest'),*nodes])
    return code


if __name__=='__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
